basic_info.description: North of Lake Street Opportunity! Spacious 4,116-square-foot Arts and Crafts home in need of a complete renovation. Spanning four levels, this 5BR residence boasts classic period details, expansive rooms and open-concept layout. Magnificent center staircase stretches across three floors, entry foyer vestibule with fireplace and Ocean Views from the top level. Bring your imagination and your contractor to preview the potential of this grand home on a highly sought after block. Garage level offers one car parking and additional space for development. Flat rear yard features mature trees and a west-facing yard that receives afternoon sunlight. Lot size 30 x 100.
